test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Name the brand under which all the fertilizers will be sold under the "One Nation One Fertilizer" scheme launched by the Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bharat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer to the given question is Option 4, Bharat.**
 
• The "One Nation One Fertilizer" scheme was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in October 2022 with an aim to provide quality fertilizers to farmers across the country at a reasonable price. Under this scheme, all the fertilizers will be sold under the brand name Bharat.
 
• The brand name Bharat signifies the unity and diversity of India as the name Bharat is derived from the ancient Indian name for India, Bharatvarsha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Bharti **is a common Indian name and is not related to the fertilizer industry.
 
• ** Bhartiya,** means "Indian" in Hindi and is a commonly used word to describe Indian products or services. However, it is not the brand name for the One Nation One Fertilizer scheme.
 
• ** Bharatwasi **means "citizen of India" in Hindi and is not related to the fertilizer industry.
